Texts: The final project is a "Lonely Schroom". This schroom is very lonely and needs to feel enough movement in front of or nearby to feel companionship, otherwise it will feel sad and scared.
The initial version of Week 9 used only a single up-and-down servo movement to show the mushroom's growth.
The second version of Week 10 involved many brainstorming sessions, but each had its own problems: either it performed oddly, or it required a huge, complex structure above.
The current final version used a wire and ground with a moving angle to effect the direction of the mushroom's swing.
